title: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
title_zh: OS-Helix：在原生计算机使用智能体中统一 GUI 交互与代码执行

paragraphs.en: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application–artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix .
paragraphs.zh: 真正的桌面自动化既非完全依赖视觉，也非完全依赖编程。 智能体必须理解面向用户的界面，同时高效操作文件、脚本和系统状态。 然而，仅通过提示层级的工具组合，无法实现原生 GUI/代码协同。 在初步实验中，直接添加代码工具反而降低了 GUI 智能体的性能，这表明 GUI/代码的路由必须通过高质量混合数据的训练内化。 我们提出了 OS-Helix，一个端到端训练的多模态计算机使用智能体，它将 GUI 操作和代码执行统一到一个动作空间中。 为构建所需的监督信号，我们引入了应用–工件组合方法：将桌面应用与真实的文件工件配对，以实例化可执行的 Ubuntu 系统状态；同时采用解耦的指令/评估器生成流程，生成基于实际环境的任务，其最终状态无论解决方案采用何种模式均可验证。 我们通过过滤后的混合数据对策略进行 SFT 预训练实现冷启动，并通过真实桌面环境中的在线强化学习进一步优化。 在强化学习方面，我们提出了“步长平衡 GSPO”方法：按动作步长而非原始助手令牌聚合重要性权重，以防止冗长的代码操作主导异构动作的优化过程。 在 OSWorld-Verified 数据集上，OS-Helix-27B 和 OS-Helix-35B-A3B 相较于其匹配的 Qwen3.5 混合基线模型，分别实现了 35.0% 和 33.7% 的相对提升；而 OS-Helix-27B-RL 进一步提升了 42.9%，成功率达到 66.44%。 消融实验结果与以下因素的作用一致：学到的 GUI/代码协同能力、可扩展的可验证监督机制，以及按动作步长平衡的优化方法；同时实验也展示了其在 WindowsAgentArena 上的跨平台迁移能力。 我们的项目主页位于 os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix。

paragraphs.en: The rapid progress of vision-language models (VLMs) ( Team, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Team et al., 2026a ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) has accelerated the development of computer-using agents (CUAs), which aim to execute open-ended tasks in human-facing digital environments. Most existing CUAs formulate digital automation as graphical interaction, where agents perceive screenshots, reason over interface states, and act through mouse and keyboard operations.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）（Team, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Team et al., 2026a ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026）的快速发展加速了计算机使用智能体（CUAs）的发展，这些智能体旨在人类面向的数字环境中执行开放式的任务。 大多数现有的计算机使用智能体将数字自动化定义为图形化交互，其中智能体通过感知屏幕截图、推理界面状态，并借助鼠标和键盘操作来执行动作。

sents.en: The rapid progress of vision-language models (VLMs) ( Team, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Team et al., 2026a ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) has accelerated the development of computer-using agents (CUAs), which aim to execute open-ended tasks in human-facing digital environments.
sents.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）（Team, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Team et al., 2026a ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026）的快速发展加速了计算机使用智能体（CUAs）的发展，这些智能体旨在人类面向的数字环境中执行开放式的任务。

sents.en: Most existing CUAs formulate digital automation as graphical interaction, where agents perceive screenshots, reason over interface states, and act through mouse and keyboard operations.
sents.zh: 大多数现有的计算机使用智能体将数字自动化定义为图形化交互，其中智能体通过感知屏幕截图、推理界面状态，并借助鼠标和键盘操作来执行动作。

paragraphs.en: However, GUI-centric CUAs ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Feizi et al., 2026 ) still face practical bottlenecks in realistic desktop workflows. Visual grounding can fail on small or ambiguous interface elements, and fine-grained interaction can make structured state manipulation cumbersome even with batched actions. A complementary interface is programmatic control, through which command-line and code agents can inspect files, access system state, and execute compound operations directly through the shell ( Yang et al., 2026e ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) . Yet code execution alone cannot fully address the long tail of desktop task scenarios that depends on visual layout, application-specific UI state, or software behavior exposed only through the interface. As illustrated in Figure 1 , these complementary strengths motivate a single agent that coordinates GUI and code, where GUI provides general visual access to arbitrary applications while code provides efficient and precise manipulation of programmatic state.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，以图形用户界面（GUI）为中心的计算用户代理（CUA）（Liu et al., 2026; Xue et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026b; Zhang et al., 2026a; Luo et al., 2025; Cheng et al., 2024; Feizi et al., 2026）在真实的桌面工作流程中仍然面临实际瓶颈。 视觉定位在小或模糊的界面元素上可能会失效，而精细交互即使结合批量操作，也会使结构化状态操控变得繁琐。 一种互补的接口是程序化控制，通过这种控制，命令行和代码智能体可以直接通过外壳检查文件、访问系统状态并执行复合操作（Yang et al., 2026e; Yang et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2025c）。 然而，仅靠代码执行无法完全解决那些依赖视觉布局、特定应用程序的UI状态或仅通过接口暴露的软件行为的长尾桌面任务场景。 如图1所示，这些互补的优势促使我们设计一个单一智能体来协调GUI和代码：GUI提供对任意应用程序的一般性视觉访问，而代码则实现对程序化状态的高效精确操控。

sents.en: However, GUI-centric CUAs ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Feizi et al., 2026 ) still face practical bottlenecks in realistic desktop workflows.

sents.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , these complementary strengths motivate a single agent that coordinates GUI and code, where GUI provides general visual access to arbitrary applications while code provides efficient and precise manipulation of programmatic state.
sents.zh: 如图1所示，这些互补的优势促使我们设计一个单一智能体来协调GUI和代码：GUI提供对任意应用程序的一般性视觉访问，而代码则实现对程序化状态的高效精确操控。

paragraphs.en: Despite this complementarity, building a native hybrid GUI/code CUA remains an open problem. Simply attaching a code tool to a GUI model does not teach it when or why to use either modality. In our preliminary experiments, as shown in Table 14 , Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) achieves over ∼ \sim 34% success on OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2025 ) with GUI actions alone, but falls to roughly ∼ \sim 32% when code execution is naively exposed. Prompt-level composition can therefore disrupt an existing GUI policy rather than create coordinated behavior, making it essential to internalize hybrid coordination capabilities into the model through training on high-quality hybrid data. Several existing approaches have explored hybrid execution paradigms that combine GUI interaction with code-like actions. Framework-centric systems ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) rely on external harnesses to coordinate GUI, code, memory, and recovery; tool-call-based approaches ( Jia et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Shi et al., 2026 ) expose programmatic operations through predefined application-specific interfaces; and model-fusion approaches ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Qin et al., 2025 ) combine complementary capabilities through predefined designs. Although these systems expand the scope of hybrid computer use, they leave open how a single policy can learn the routing between the GUI and code actions through hybrid training.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这种互补性，构建原生的混合 GUI/代码 CUA 仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。 仅仅将代码工具附加到 GUI 模型上，并不会教会它何时或为何使用这两种模态中的任何一种。 在我们的初步实验中，如表 14 所示，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct（Bai 等人，2025）仅通过 GUI 操作在 OSWorld-Verified（Xie 等人，2025）上的成功率超过 ∼ \sim 34%，但当简单暴露代码执行时，该成功率会降至约 ∼ \sim 32%。 因此，提示层级的组合可能会破坏现有的 GUI 策略，而非产生协调一致的行为，这使得通过高质量混合数据训练将混合协调能力内化到模型中变得至关重要。 一些现有方法已经探索了结合 GUI 交互与类代码操作的混合执行范式。 框架中心化的系统（Gonzalez-Pumariega 等人，2025；Hou 等人，2024；Yang 等人，2026a）依赖外部框架来协调 GUI、代码、内存和恢复功能；工具调用类方法（Jia 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2025b；Shi 等人，2026）通过预定义的应用特定接口暴露程序化操作；而模型融合方法（Wang 等人，2025a；Qin 等人，2025）则通过预定义的设计结合互补能力。 尽管这些系统扩展了混合计算机使用的范围，但它们仍未解决单一策略如何通过混合训练学习 GUI 与代码操作之间的路由问题。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained computer-using agent that unifies GUI interaction and code execution within a single policy.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 OS-Helix——一个端到端训练的计算机使用智能体，它将 GUI 交互与代码执行统一到了单一策略中。

paragraphs.en: On the infrastructure side, we introduce application–artifact composition, which combines versioned applications with authentic artifacts to instantiate diverse and reproducible desktop states. An Exploration Agent proposes instructions grounded in these states through brief exploration of the initialized environment, while an independent Evaluator Agent constructs task-specific, primarily rule-based evaluators. Together, this pipeline supports scalable synthesis, filtering, and collection of high-quality GUI/code trajectories for model training, thereby providing the data foundation necessary to internalize hybrid coordination capabilities into the model.
paragraphs.zh: 在基础设施层面，我们引入了应用–工件组合机制，该机制将带版本的应用程序与经过验证的工件相结合，以实例化多样化且可复现的桌面状态。 探索智能体通过简要探索初始化的环境，基于这些状态提出指令；而独立的评估智能体则构建针对特定任务、主要基于规则的评估器。 这一流程共同支持高质量 GUI/代码轨迹的可扩展合成、筛选与收集，用于模型训练，从而为将混合协调能力内化到模型中提供必要的数据基础。

sents.en: On the infrastructure side, we introduce application–artifact composition, which combines versioned applications with authentic artifacts to instantiate diverse and reproducible desktop states.
sents.zh: 在基础设施层面，我们引入了应用–工件组合机制，该机制将带版本的应用程序与经过验证的工件相结合，以实例化多样化且可复现的桌面状态。

sents.en: An Exploration Agent proposes instructions grounded in these states through brief exploration of the initialized environment, while an independent Evaluator Agent constructs task-specific, primarily rule-based evaluators.
sents.zh: 探索智能体通过简要探索初始化的环境，基于这些状态提出指令；而独立的评估智能体则构建针对特定任务、主要基于规则的评估器。

sents.en: Together, this pipeline supports scalable synthesis, filtering, and collection of high-quality GUI/code trajectories for model training, thereby providing the data foundation necessary to internalize hybrid coordination capabilities into the model.
sents.zh: 这一流程共同支持高质量 GUI/代码轨迹的可扩展合成、筛选与收集，用于模型训练，从而为将混合协调能力内化到模型中提供必要的数据基础。

paragraphs.en: On the training side, we first use filtered hybrid trajectories to internalize basic action semantics and modality routing, and then optimize the policy through online RL in executable desktop environments. In early RL experiments, we observe a steady increase in the proportion of code actions accompanied by a degradation in performance. We attribute this to the token-count asymmetry between short GUI actions and substantially longer code actions, which causes the optimization signal to be dominated by code steps. To address this, we propose Step-balanced GSPO , which constructs the sample-level importance ratio over action steps rather than raw assistant-token counts, enabling more balanced optimization of the two modalities. These training components directly answer the open question of how a single policy can natively learn to coordinate GUI and code actions through hybrid training, yielding an agent that performs strongly and reliably across diverse desktop tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练方面，我们首先使用经过过滤的混合轨迹来内化基本动作语义和模态路由，然后通过可执行的桌面环境中的在线强化学习来优化策略。 在早期的强化学习实验中，我们观察到代码动作的比例持续上升，但性能却随之下降。 我们认为这是因为简短的 GUI 动作与明显更长的代码动作之间存在词元数量不对称性，导致优化信号主要由代码步骤主导。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“步长平衡 GSPO”，该方法在样本层面基于动作步长而非原始助手词元数量来计算重要性比率，从而能够更均衡地优化两种模态。 这些训练组件直接回答了这样一个开放性问题：如何通过混合训练让单一策略原生地学会协调 GUI 和代码动作，最终生成一个能在多样化桌面任务中表现出色且可靠的智能体。

sents.en: On the training side, we first use filtered hybrid trajectories to internalize basic action semantics and modality routing, and then optimize the policy through online RL in executable desktop environments.
sents.zh: 在训练方面，我们首先使用经过过滤的混合轨迹来内化基本动作语义和模态路由，然后通过可执行的桌面环境中的在线强化学习来优化策略。

sents.en: In early RL experiments, we observe a steady increase in the proportion of code actions accompanied by a degradation in performance.
sents.zh: 在早期的强化学习实验中，我们观察到代码动作的比例持续上升，但性能却随之下降。

sents.en: We attribute this to the token-count asymmetry between short GUI actions and substantially longer code actions, which causes the optimization signal to be dominated by code steps.
sents.zh: 我们认为这是因为简短的 GUI 动作与明显更长的代码动作之间存在词元数量不对称性，导致优化信号主要由代码步骤主导。

sents.en: To address this, we propose Step-balanced GSPO , which constructs the sample-level importance ratio over action steps rather than raw assistant-token counts, enabling more balanced optimization of the two modalities.
sents.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“步长平衡 GSPO”，该方法在样本层面基于动作步长而非原始助手词元数量来计算重要性比率，从而能够更均衡地优化两种模态。

sents.en: These training components directly answer the open question of how a single policy can natively learn to coordinate GUI and code actions through hybrid training, yielding an agent that performs strongly and reliably across diverse desktop tasks.
sents.zh: 这些训练组件直接回答了这样一个开放性问题：如何通过混合训练让单一策略原生地学会协调 GUI 和代码动作，最终生成一个能在多样化桌面任务中表现出色且可靠的智能体。

paragraphs.en: 1) We formulate native GUI/code hybrid computer use as an end-to-end policy-learning problem and show through controlled experiments that merely exposing a GUI policy to code execution fails to yield reliable routing, motivating the need to internalize coordination through hybrid training.
paragraphs.zh: 1) 我们将原生GUI/代码混合计算机使用问题构建为一个端到端的策略学习问题，并通过受控实验表明，仅让GUI策略接触代码执行并无法产生可靠的路线规划，这凸显了通过混合训练实现内部协调的必要性。

paragraphs.en: 2) We introduce application–artifact composition and a decoupled instruction/evaluator synthesis pipeline to construct diverse, reproducible, executable desktop states and generate high-quality hybrid data for internalizing GUI and code execution capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 2) 我们引入了应用–工件组合以及解耦的指令/评估器合成流程，以构建多样化、可重复且可执行的桌面状态，并生成高质量的混合数据，从而内化 GUI 和代码执行能力。

paragraphs.en: 3) We propose Step-balanced GSPO for the agentic RL stage of native hybrid policy training, which prevents long code actions from dominating optimization, and enables a single policy to learn GUI and code coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 3) 我们为原生混合策略训练的智能体强化学习阶段提出了“步长平衡”GSPO方法，该方法可防止冗长的代码操作主导优化过程，并使单一策略能够学会GUI与代码的协同操作。

paragraphs.en: 4) We will release the OS-Helix model family and research artifacts, including the desktop data-synthesis and RL environments, task and trajectory collection pipelines, approximately 9K generated instructions, 83K unfiltered SFT samples, and about 31K successful filtered SFT samples in the unified GUI/code action space.
paragraphs.zh: 4) 我们将发布 OS-Helix 模型系列和研究成果，包括桌面端数据合成与强化学习（RL）环境、任务与轨迹收集流程、约 9000 条生成的指令、83000 条未经过滤的 SFT 样本，以及约 31000 条成功过滤后的 SFT 样本，所有内容都将整合在统一的 GUI/代码操作空间中。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid GUI/Code Computer-Using Agents. Traditional GUI-native agents learn screenshot-to-action policies over visual interface states ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025d ) , whereas command-line and coding agents operate over files, shells, and programmatic state ( Anthropic, 2025a ; OpenClaw, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Their complementary strengths motivate hybrid computer use. Framework-centric systems ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) coordinate GUI, code, memory, and recovery through external harnesses, often using strong proprietary models. Their performance is coupled to costly inference and hand-engineered orchestration, making the model’s own hybrid coordination difficult to isolate. Tool-call-based approaches ( Jia et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Shi et al., 2026 ) expose programmatic operations through predefined, application-specific interfaces, limiting coverage and transfer to available integrations and tool schemas. Some approaches integrate GUI, code, and other capabilities through model fusion ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , relying on predefined fusion rather than coordination learned within a single policy. Qwen-UI-Agent ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) also explores training with mixed GUI and code-like action capabilities, demonstrating the practical potential of native hybrid agents. However, existing studies describe data construction, executable environments, supervision, and training configurations at different levels of granularity, making controlled reproduction and comparison of learned coordination mechanisms difficult. Our work complements by studying executable application–artifact state construction, decoupled instruction–evaluator synthesis, and more stable optimization for training a single GUI/code policy.
paragraphs.zh: 混合 GUI/代码计算机使用智能体。 传统的原生 GUI 智能体通过视觉界面状态学习“截图到操作”策略（Qin et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026b；Wu et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2025d），而命令行和编码智能体则操作文件、外壳和程序状态（Anthropic, 2025a；OpenClaw, 2026；Yang et al., 2026b；Yang et al., 2024）。 它们互补的优势推动了混合计算机使用方式的发展。 以框架为中心的系统（Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025；Hou et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2026a）通过外部控制机制协调 GUI、代码、记忆和恢复功能，通常依赖强大的专有模型。 其性能与高成本的推理和人工设计的协调机制紧密耦合，使得难以单独评估模型自身的混合协调能力。 基于工具调用的方法（Jia et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2025b；Shi et al., 2026）通过预定义的应用特定接口暴露程序操作，但其覆盖范围受限于可用的集成和工具方案，难以迁移。 一些方法通过模型融合将 GUI、代码和其他能力整合在一起（Wang et al., 2025a；Qin et al., 2025），依赖预定义的融合机制，而非在单一策略中学习的协调能力。 Qwen-UI-Agent（Zhou et al., 2026a）也探索了结合 GUI 和类代码操作能力的混合训练，展示了原生混合智能体的实际潜力。 然而，现有研究在不同颗粒度上描述了数据构建、可执行环境、监督机制和训练配置，这使得对所学协调能力机制的受控复现和比较变得困难。 我们的工作通过研究可执行应用与产物状态的构建、解耦的指令-评估器合成，以及更稳定的优化方法，为训练单一的 GUI/代码策略提供了补充。

paragraphs.en: Environment Scaling and Task Synthesis for Computer-Using Agents. Realistic long-horizon tasks and interactive environments are essential for training CUAs, yet manual task design and trajectory annotation are expensive and difficult to scale. This makes automated acquisition of high-quality instructions and demonstrations a central problem. One line of work crawls web tutorials and documentation and decomposes them into executable task instructions ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Another line starts from the target environment itself and infers tasks from what the agent can observe or manipulate: Explorer ( Pahuja et al., 2025 ) extracts and refines task intents from web entry pages, while OS-Genesis ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , GUI-ReWalk ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , TreeCUA ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and AUTO PLAY ( Ramrakhya et al., 2026 ) synthesize tasks through exploratory interaction with the environment. These methods primarily scale task and trajectory synthesis, but they do not substantially scale the underlying interactive worlds, which constrains the diversity of behaviors learned by the agent. Unlike more constrained interaction domains such as web and mobile ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) , PC environments, such as Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS, provide a natural substrate for scalable CUA training through system-level code execution, mature application ecosystems, persistent file systems, and package managers, enabling verifiable tasks grounded in concrete system state ( Sun et al., 2026a ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . Recent work has begun to use virtual machines to expand desktop environments and synthesize tasks ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , exploring different parts of desktop-state construction and task generation. Table 6 summarizes the reported coverage of existing task-synthesis pipelines. Existing efforts differ in the extent to which they scale applications, authentic artifacts, executable initial states, and verifiable terminal conditions. Our pipeline integrates application–artifact composition, reproducible desktop-state construction, and environment-grounded instruction and evaluator synthesis into a unified framework for scalable, verifiable desktop-task generation.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用智能体的环境扩展与任务合成。 真实且长时域的任务和交互式环境对于训练计算机使用智能体（CUA）至关重要，但手动设计任务和标注轨迹既昂贵又难以扩展。 这使得高质量指令和演示的自动化获取成为一个核心问题。 一类研究通过抓取网络教程和文档，并将其分解为可执行的任务指令（Xu et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026a）。 另一类研究则从目标环境本身出发，根据智能体能够观察或操作的内容推断任务：Explorer（Pahuja et al., 2025）从网页入口页面中提取并提炼任务意图，而 OS-Genesis（Sun et al., 2025）、GUI-ReWalk（Lin et al., 2025）、TreeCUA（Jiang et al., 2026）和 AUTO PLAY（Ramrakhya et al., 2026）则通过与环境进行探索性交互来合成任务。 这些方法主要扩展了任务和轨迹的合成能力，但并未显著扩展其底层的交互式世界，从而限制了智能体所学习行为的多样性。 与网页和移动设备等限制较多的交互领域（Cao et al., 2026; Zhang et al., 2026c; Wu et al., 2026; Tang et al., 2026b; Cheng et al., 2026; Yan et al., 2026）不同，Ubuntu、Windows 和 macOS 等个人计算机环境通过系统级代码执行、成熟的应用程序生态系统、持久文件系统以及包管理器，为可扩展的 CUA 训练提供了天然基础，从而能够生成基于具体系统状态的、可验证的任务（Sun et al., 2026a; Fu et al., 2026）。 近期的研究已开始利用虚拟机来扩展桌面环境并合成任务（Wang et al., 2026a; Lv et al., 2026; Huang et al., 2026），探索桌面状态构建和任务生成的不同方面。 表 6 总结了现有任务合成流程所报告的覆盖范围。 现有方法在应用程序、真实数字资产、可执行的初始状态以及可验证的最终条件的扩展程度上存在差异。 我们的流程将应用程序与数字资产的组合、可复现的桌面状态构建，以及基于环境的指令和评估器合成整合到一个统一框架中，以实现可扩展且可验证的桌面任务生成。

paragraphs.en: Training Paradigms for Computer-Using Agents. CUA training has broadly evolved from imitation-style supervised fine-tuning toward reinforcement learning in interactive environments. SFT-based systems learn action formats, visual grounding, and task execution from human demonstrations, synthetic trajectories, web tutorials, or teacher-model rollouts ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Between SFT and online interaction, offline preference-optimization methods such as DPO ( Gao et al., 2026 ) and offline GRPO ( Yang et al., 2026c ) improve policies from static preference data, but remain limited by the coverage of collected trajectories and cannot directly optimize recovery under environment feedback. Online RL methods for CUAs are further split into grounding RL and agentic RL. Grounding RL optimizes low-level GUI localization or action selection with specialized visual rewards ( Lu et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ; Tang et al., 2026a ; Feizi et al., 2026 ) . Agentic RL instead optimizes complete trajectories in executable environments with rule-based or verifiable rewards. Recent CUA work has begun to tailor the optimization algorithm to this setting: ComputerRL ( Lai et al., 2026 ) introduces Entropulse, which alternates online RL with SFT to mitigate entropy collapse; CUA-Gym ( Wang et al., 2026a ) trains CUA checkpoints with GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; and ScaleCUA ( Lv et al., 2026 ) adopts GRPO-style RL ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) together with frontier sampling and visual-context segmentation. EvoCUA-1.5 ( Huang et al., 2026 ) proposes Step-Level Policy Optimization for decomposed multi-turn samples. Nevertheless, how to systematically train a single policy to route between native GUI and code actions while maintaining stable optimization across heterogeneous action granularities remains underexplored. Our work addresses this setting through hybrid SFT and online agentic RL with Step-balanced GSPO, mitigating optimization imbalance and enabling more effective native coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用智能体的训练范式。 CUA 的训练已从模仿式监督微调广泛演进为在交互式环境中的强化学习。 基于 SFT 的系统通过人类演示、合成轨迹、网络教程或教师模型的执行过程来学习动作格式、视觉定位和任务执行（Cheng 等，2024；Qin 等，2025；Wang 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026a；Sun 等，2025；Liu 等，2026）。 在 SFT 和在线交互之间，诸如 DPO（Gao 等，2026）和离线 GRPO（Yang 等，2026c）之类的离线偏好优化方法能够从静态偏好数据中改进策略，但仍受所收集轨迹覆盖范围的限制，且无法直接优化对环境反馈的恢复能力。 针对 CUAs 的在线 RL 方法进一步分为视觉定位 RL 和智能体 RL。 视觉定位 RL 通过专门的视觉奖励来优化低层级的 GUI 定位或动作选择（Lu 等，2026b；Yuan 等，2025；Zhou 等，2026b；Tang 等，2026a；Feizi 等，2026）。 相比之下，智能体 RL 则通过基于规则或可验证的奖励，在可执行环境中优化完整的轨迹。 近期的 CUA 研究已开始针对这一场景定制优化算法：ComputerRL（Lai 等，2026）引入了 Entropulse，该方法交替使用在线 RL 和 SFT 以缓解熵值坍缩；CUA-Gym（Wang 等，2026a）使用 GSPO（Zheng 等，2025）训练 CUA 检查点；而 ScaleCUA（Lv 等，2026）则采用了 GRPO 风格的 RL（Shao 等，2024；Yu 等，2026），并结合了前沿采样和视觉上下文分割。 EvoCUA-1.5（Huang 等，2026）为分解后的多轮次样本提出了“步骤级策略优化”。 然而，如何系统地训练一个单一策略，使其能够在原生 GUI 动作与代码动作之间进行路由，同时保持在不同动作粒度下的稳定优化，仍是一个未被充分探索的问题。 我们的研究通过混合 SFT 和在线智能体 RL，并结合“步骤平衡”GSPO 来应对这一场景，从而缓解优化失衡问题，并实现更有效的原生动作协调。

sents.en: Training Paradigms for Computer-Using Agents.
sents.zh: 计算机使用智能体的训练范式。

sents.en: CUA training has broadly evolved from imitation-style supervised fine-tuning toward reinforcement learning in interactive environments.
sents.zh: CUA 的训练已从模仿式监督微调广泛演进为在交互式环境中的强化学习。

sents.en: SFT-based systems learn action formats, visual grounding, and task execution from human demonstrations, synthetic trajectories, web tutorials, or teacher-model rollouts ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 基于 SFT 的系统通过人类演示、合成轨迹、网络教程或教师模型的执行过程来学习动作格式、视觉定位和任务执行（Cheng 等，2024；Qin 等，2025；Wang 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026a；Sun 等，2025；Liu 等，2026）。

sents.en: Between SFT and online interaction, offline preference-optimization methods such as DPO ( Gao et al., 2026 ) and offline GRPO ( Yang et al., 2026c ) improve policies from static preference data, but remain limited by the coverage of collected trajectories and cannot directly optimize recovery under environment feedback.
sents.zh: 在 SFT 和在线交互之间，诸如 DPO（Gao 等，2026）和离线 GRPO（Yang 等，2026c）之类的离线偏好优化方法能够从静态偏好数据中改进策略，但仍受所收集轨迹覆盖范围的限制，且无法直接优化对环境反馈的恢复能力。

sents.en: Online RL methods for CUAs are further split into grounding RL and agentic RL.
sents.zh: 针对 CUAs 的在线 RL 方法进一步分为视觉定位 RL 和智能体 RL。

sents.en: Grounding RL optimizes low-level GUI localization or action selection with specialized visual rewards ( Lu et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ; Tang et al., 2026a ; Feizi et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 视觉定位 RL 通过专门的视觉奖励来优化低层级的 GUI 定位或动作选择（Lu 等，2026b；Yuan 等，2025；Zhou 等，2026b；Tang 等，2026a；Feizi 等，2026）。

sents.en: Agentic RL instead optimizes complete trajectories in executable environments with rule-based or verifiable rewards.
sents.zh: 相比之下，智能体 RL 则通过基于规则或可验证的奖励，在可执行环境中优化完整的轨迹。

sents.en: Recent CUA work has begun to tailor the optimization algorithm to this setting: ComputerRL ( Lai et al., 2026 ) introduces Entropulse, which alternates online RL with SFT to mitigate entropy collapse; CUA-Gym ( Wang et al., 2026a ) trains CUA checkpoints with GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; and ScaleCUA ( Lv et al., 2026 ) adopts GRPO-style RL ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) together with frontier sampling and visual-context segmentation.
sents.zh: 近期的 CUA 研究已开始针对这一场景定制优化算法：ComputerRL（Lai 等，2026）引入了 Entropulse，该方法交替使用在线 RL 和 SFT 以缓解熵值坍缩；CUA-Gym（Wang 等，2026a）使用 GSPO（Zheng 等，2025）训练 CUA 检查点；而 ScaleCUA（Lv 等，2026）则采用了 GRPO 风格的 RL（Shao 等，2024；Yu 等，2026），并结合了前沿采样和视觉上下文分割。

sents.en: EvoCUA-1.5 ( Huang et al., 2026 ) proposes Step-Level Policy Optimization for decomposed multi-turn samples.
sents.zh: EvoCUA-1.5（Huang 等，2026）为分解后的多轮次样本提出了“步骤级策略优化”。

sents.en: Nevertheless, how to systematically train a single policy to route between native GUI and code actions while maintaining stable optimization across heterogeneous action granularities remains underexplored.
sents.zh: 然而，如何系统地训练一个单一策略，使其能够在原生 GUI 动作与代码动作之间进行路由，同时保持在不同动作粒度下的稳定优化，仍是一个未被充分探索的问题。

sents.en: Our work addresses this setting through hybrid SFT and online agentic RL with Step-balanced GSPO, mitigating optimization imbalance and enabling more effective native coordination.
sents.zh: 我们的研究通过混合 SFT 和在线智能体 RL，并结合“步骤平衡”GSPO 来应对这一场景，从而缓解优化失衡问题，并实现更有效的原生动作协调。

paragraphs.en: An overview of the OS-Helix pipeline is shown in Figure 2 . OS-Helix is built around a simple premise: a real computer-using agent should treat GUI interaction and code execution as two complementary ways of changing the same digital state. Rather than attaching a shell tool to a GUI model at inference time, we construct a unified pipeline in which environments, instructions, trajectories, and reinforcement signals are all designed for hybrid GUI/code execution.
paragraphs.zh: OS-Helix 流程的概述如图 2 所示。 OS-Helix 基于一个简单的理念构建而成：一个真实的计算机使用智能体应将 GUI 交互和代码执行视为改变同一数字状态的两种互补方式。 我们并未在推理阶段将外壳工具附加到 GUI 模型上，而是构建了一个统一的流程，其中环境、指令、轨迹和强化信号均专为混合的 GUI/代码执行而设计。

paragraphs.en: The scale of computer-using agent training is ultimately bounded by the diversity of executable states from which meaningful tasks can arise. This is particularly important on desktops, where workflows are shaped jointly by applications, user artifacts, and persistent local state. We view authentic artifacts as a natural axis for expanding this state space, with artifact types and file formats providing a direct link to the applications that can operate on them. Based on this principle, we construct diverse executable desktop environments and synthesize grounded, verifiable tasks from the resulting states.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机智能体训练的范围最终受到可执行状态多样性的限制，而正是这些状态能够产生有意义的任务。 这一点在桌面环境中尤为重要，因为工作流程是由应用程序、用户生成的产物以及持久的本地状态共同塑造的。 我们将真实的产物视为扩展这一状态空间的自然维度，其中产物的类型和文件格式为能够操作它们的应用程序提供了直接关联。 基于这一原则，我们构建多样化的可执行桌面环境，并从由此产生的状态中合成具有现实依据且可验证的任务。

sents.en: The scale of computer-using agent training is ultimately bounded by the diversity of executable states from which meaningful tasks can arise.
sents.zh: 计算机智能体训练的范围最终受到可执行状态多样性的限制，而正是这些状态能够产生有意义的任务。

sents.en: This is particularly important on desktops, where workflows are shaped jointly by applications, user artifacts, and persistent local state.
sents.zh: 这一点在桌面环境中尤为重要，因为工作流程是由应用程序、用户生成的产物以及持久的本地状态共同塑造的。

sents.en: We view authentic artifacts as a natural axis for expanding this state space, with artifact types and file formats providing a direct link to the applications that can operate on them.
sents.zh: 我们将真实的产物视为扩展这一状态空间的自然维度，其中产物的类型和文件格式为能够操作它们的应用程序提供了直接关联。

sents.en: Based on this principle, we construct diverse executable desktop environments and synthesize grounded, verifiable tasks from the resulting states.
sents.zh: 基于这一原则，我们构建多样化的可执行桌面环境，并从由此产生的状态中合成具有现实依据且可验证的任务。

paragraphs.en: Real-world desktop workflows are commonly grounded in existing artifacts that are read, edited, or transformed through applications. Thus, we factor scalable desktop-environment construction into two reusable components: applications with fixed versions, launch procedures, and diverse initialization configurations, and artifacts carrying authentic content and persistent state. Their compatibility-aware composition produces executable desktop states from which realistic tasks can arise.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的桌面工作流程通常基于现有资源，这些资源通过应用程序被读取、编辑或转换。 因此，我们将可扩展的桌面环境构建分解为两个可重用的组件：具有固定版本、启动程序和多样化初始化配置的应用程序，以及承载真实内容和持久状态的资源。 它们兼容性的组合能够生成可执行的桌面状态，从而产生真实的任务。

sents.en: Real-world desktop workflows are commonly grounded in existing artifacts that are read, edited, or transformed through applications.
sents.zh: 现实世界中的桌面工作流程通常基于现有资源，这些资源通过应用程序被读取、编辑或转换。

sents.en: Thus, we factor scalable desktop-environment construction into two reusable components: applications with fixed versions, launch procedures, and diverse initialization configurations, and artifacts carrying authentic content and persistent state.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将可扩展的桌面环境构建分解为两个可重用的组件：具有固定版本、启动程序和多样化初始化配置的应用程序，以及承载真实内容和持久状态的资源。

sents.en: Their compatibility-aware composition produces executable desktop states from which realistic tasks can arise.
sents.zh: 它们兼容性的组合能够生成可执行的桌面状态，从而产生真实的任务。

paragraphs.en: To instantiate such states at scale, we organize artifacts and applications into an application–artifact compatibility graph , whose edges are determined by the artifact types and file formats that applications can consume. The underlying application configuration records these supported input types, together with the version, launch commands, and initialization settings required for reproducible execution. For example, a .pptx artifact can be connected to LibreOffice Impress and WPS Presentation directly, whose application configurations specify how each application is launched with the file and which application-specific initialization settings are required. The resulting states are instantiated on reproducible Ubuntu virtual machines for task synthesis and trajectory collection.
paragraphs.zh: 为了大规模实例化这些状态，我们将工件和应用组织成一个应用–工件兼容性图，其边由应用可以使用的工件类型和文件格式决定。 底层的应用配置记录了这些受支持输入类型，以及可重复执行所需的版本、启动命令和初始化设置。 例如，一个 .pptx 工件可以直接连接到 LibreOffice Impress 和 WPS Presentation，它们的应用配置指定了每个应用如何与该文件一起启动，以及需要哪些应用特定的初始化设置。 最终生成的状态会在可重复的 Ubuntu 虚拟机上实例化，用于任务合成和轨迹收集。

sents.en: To instantiate such states at scale, we organize artifacts and applications into an application–artifact compatibility graph , whose edges are determined by the artifact types and file formats that applications can consume.
sents.zh: 为了大规模实例化这些状态，我们将工件和应用组织成一个应用–工件兼容性图，其边由应用可以使用的工件类型和文件格式决定。

sents.en: The underlying application configuration records these supported input types, together with the version, launch commands, and initialization settings required for reproducible execution.
sents.zh: 底层的应用配置记录了这些受支持输入类型，以及可重复执行所需的版本、启动命令和初始化设置。

sents.en: For example, a .pptx artifact can be connected to LibreOffice Impress and WPS Presentation directly, whose application configurations specify how each application is launched with the file and which application-specific initialization settings are required.
sents.zh: 例如，一个 .pptx 工件可以直接连接到 LibreOffice Impress 和 WPS Presentation，它们的应用配置指定了每个应用如何与该文件一起启动，以及需要哪些应用特定的初始化设置。

sents.en: The resulting states are instantiated on reproducible Ubuntu virtual machines for task synthesis and trajectory collection.
sents.zh: 最终生成的状态会在可重复的 Ubuntu 虚拟机上实例化，用于任务合成和轨迹收集。

paragraphs.en: Given the diverse desktop environments constructed above, we next translate environment diversity into training-task diversity. Each synthesis episode first samples a target application and then selects compatible artifacts via the application–artifact compatibility graph , thereby instantiating a coherent and executable task context.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于上述构建的多样化桌面环境，我们接下来将环境多样性转化为训练任务的多样性。 每次合成过程首先采样一个目标应用程序，然后通过应用程序–工件兼容性图选择兼容的工件，从而实例化一个连贯且可执行的任务上下文。

sents.en: Given the diverse desktop environments constructed above, we next translate environment diversity into training-task diversity.
sents.zh: 鉴于上述构建的多样化桌面环境，我们接下来将环境多样性转化为训练任务的多样性。

sents.en: Each synthesis episode first samples a target application and then selects compatible artifacts via the application–artifact compatibility graph , thereby instantiating a coherent and executable task context.
sents.zh: 每次合成过程首先采样一个目标应用程序，然后通过应用程序–工件兼容性图选择兼容的工件，从而实例化一个连贯且可执行的任务上下文。

paragraphs.en: Relying primarily on model priors tends to produce generic, repetitive instruction patterns and underutilize the state diversity of instantiated environments at scale. We therefore ground instruction generation in active exploration of the current environment. To avoid repeatedly covering familiar functionality, we maintain a global application memory that records functions previously exercised for each application and exposes this history during subsequent exploration, encouraging broader coverage over time. The Exploration Agent receives this memory together with application metadata, exact file paths, launch configuration, tutorial, and initial screenshot, and performs a short non-destructive exploration restricted to opening, clicking, scrolling, and terminating. Based on the observed artifact content and application state, it proposes a realistic user instruction together with its initialization configuration and observable success conditions, without prescribing a GUI/code solution or revealing answer-critical information.
paragraphs.zh: 主要依赖模型先验知识往往会生成通用且重复的指令模式，并未能充分利用实例化环境在大规模运行时的状态多样性。 因此，我们将指令生成建立在对当前环境的主动探索之上。 为避免反复涉及已熟悉的功能，我们维护一个全局应用内存，用于记录每个应用中先前执行过的功能，并在后续探索时展示这一历史，以鼓励随时间推移实现更广泛的覆盖。 探索智能体接收该内存以及应用元数据、精确文件路径、启动配置、教程和初始截图，并执行一次简短的非破坏性探索，操作仅限于打开、点击、滚动和终止。 基于观察到的产物内容和应用状态，它会提出一个符合实际的用户指令，同时提供其初始化配置和可观测的成功条件，但不会指定 GUI/代码解决方案或透露关键答案信息。

sents.en: The Exploration Agent receives this memory together with application metadata, exact file paths, launch configuration, tutorial, and initial screenshot, and performs a short non-destructive exploration restricted to opening, clicking, scrolling, and terminating.
sents.zh: 探索智能体接收该内存以及应用元数据、精确文件路径、启动配置、教程和初始截图，并执行一次简短的非破坏性探索，操作仅限于打开、点击、滚动和终止。

sents.en: Based on the observed artifact content and application state, it proposes a realistic user instruction together with its initialization configuration and observable success conditions, without prescribing a GUI/code solution or revealing answer-critical information.
sents.zh: 基于观察到的产物内容和应用状态，它会提出一个符合实际的用户指令，同时提供其初始化配置和可观测的成功条件，但不会指定 GUI/代码解决方案或透露关键答案信息。

paragraphs.en: To make synthesized tasks consistently verifiable, we adopt an everything-is-a-file abstraction in which terminal conditions are mapped, whenever possible, to inspectable file representations, and evaluator synthesis selects rule-based, VLM-based, or hybrid checks according to their observability. Verification specifies the desired terminal state without constraining how it is reached, allowing the same task to be completed through GUI interaction, code execution, or their combination.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保合成任务始终具备可验证性，我们采用了一种“一切皆为文件”的抽象方法：尽可能将终止条件映射为可检查的文件表示形式，而评估器合成则根据规则检查、VLM 检查或混合检查的可观察性来选择相应方式。 验证过程定义了期望的终止状态，但并不限制达成该状态的具体方式，因此同一任务既可以通过 GUI 交互完成，也可以通过代码执行完成，或者两者结合实现。

sents.en: To make synthesized tasks consistently verifiable, we adopt an everything-is-a-file abstraction in which terminal conditions are mapped, whenever possible, to inspectable file representations, and evaluator synthesis selects rule-based, VLM-based, or hybrid checks according to their observability.
sents.zh: 为确保合成任务始终具备可验证性，我们采用了一种“一切皆为文件”的抽象方法：尽可能将终止条件映射为可检查的文件表示形式，而评估器合成则根据规则检查、VLM 检查或混合检查的可观察性来选择相应方式。

sents.en: Verification specifies the desired terminal state without constraining how it is reached, allowing the same task to be completed through GUI interaction, code execution, or their combination.
sents.zh: 验证过程定义了期望的终止状态，但并不限制达成该状态的具体方式，因此同一任务既可以通过 GUI 交互完成，也可以通过代码执行完成，或者两者结合实现。

paragraphs.en: We decouple the instruction proposal from evaluator synthesis. Once an instruction proposal is accepted, its instruction and success conditions are frozen and passed to an independent Evaluator Agent , which compiles the corresponding verification logic. Programmatically observable conditions are evaluated primarily with rule-based checks over VM files and command-line state, while visual conditions that cannot be reliably recovered programmatically are handled with VLM-based evaluation. Instructions and evaluators are validated separately in the pipeline. Instructions are checked for reachability, unambiguity, realism, and sufficient verification conditions, while evaluators must compile and assign zero reward to the initial state. Invalid evaluators are repaired when possible. Each validated instruction and evaluator then constitutes a task, after which semantically near-duplicate tasks are removed. Together, environment-grounded synthesis and file-backed verification produce a scalable pool of verifiable tasks shared by SFT trajectory collection and online RL. Data infrastructure details are provided in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: Most open-source CUAs used as base models have previously been trained primarily for GUI-only interaction. They may possess visual understanding, coordinate grounding, and low-level control, but have not learned the new decision boundary created when code execution becomes an equally valid action. Merely adding a code tool expands the action space without supplying a routing prior for when to remain in the GUI, when to switch to code, and when to return to the interface for verification; it can even disrupt already learned GUI behavior. SFT therefore serves as a cold start in our pipeline: it establishes the action semantics of the unified tool schema and distills from teacher trajectories a coarse but usable GUI/code routing policy. We collect SFT trajectories on tasks produced by the data infrastructure described in Section 3.2 , using Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) as the teacher model with both Computer Use and Bash Tool enabled. The resulting trajectories are then postprocessed and normalized into the OS-Helix action schema. Each trajectory is scored by its evaluator, using the teacher model itself when visual judgment is required, and the resulting score serves as the primary signal for rejection sampling. We further apply a filtering pipeline to remove malformed tool calls, schema-mismatched actions, and trajectories that fail evaluator or quality checks, yielding a set of high-quality SFT samples. Training hyperparameters and data-mixture details are provided in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 大多数用作基础模型的开源CUA此前主要训练用于纯GUI交互。 它们可能具备视觉理解、坐标定位和底层控制能力，但尚未学会在代码执行成为同等有效操作时形成的新决策边界。 仅仅添加一个代码工具会扩展动作空间，却无法提供关于何时留在GUI、何时切换到代码、以及何时返回界面进行验证的路由先验；甚至可能干扰已学到的GUI行为。 因此，SFT在我们的流程中充当冷启动环节：它确立了统一工具方案的动作语义，并从教师轨迹中提炼出一种粗略但可用的GUI/代码路由策略。 我们基于第3.2节所述的数据基础设施生成的任务收集SFT轨迹，并使用Claude Sonnet 4.6（Anthropic, 2026）作为教师模型，同时启用计算机使用和Bash工具功能。 随后，对生成的轨迹进行后处理和标准化，使其符合OS-Helix动作方案。 每条轨迹由其评估器打分：当需要视觉判断时，使用教师模型本身进行评估，所得分数则作为拒绝采样的主要信号。 我们进一步应用过滤流程，移除格式错误的工具调用、与方案不匹配的动作以及未能通过评估器或质量检查的轨迹，最终得到一组高质量的SFT样本。 训练超参数和数据混合细节见附录C.1。

paragraphs.en: We first build a cross-node environment management system that monitors and manages over one hundred Ubuntu sandbox environments across multiple standalone machines. The system exposes a unified port to the training side and internally dispatches requests to the environments. We then perform online RL on carefully filtered generated tasks with rule-based evaluators only, further improving model performance. Each rollout interacts with a live desktop environment, and the paired evaluator score serves as the sole outcome reward signal. If an assistant turn contains an unparsable tool call or any other invalid action-format error, that assistant response is isolated as an invalid sample and assigned a reward of 0 0 , even if the remaining trajectory could receive a positive evaluator score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先构建了一个跨节点环境管理系统，用于监控和管理分布在多台独立机器上的超过一百个 Ubuntu 沙盒环境。 该系统向训练端提供一个统一端口，并在内部将请求分发到各个环境中。 接着，我们仅使用基于规则的评价器，对经过仔细筛选的生成任务进行在线强化学习，从而进一步提升模型性能。 每次展开过程都会与真实的桌面环境进行交互，而配套评价器的得分则作为唯一的成果奖励信号。 如果某个助手回合包含无法解析的工具调用或任何其他无效的动作格式错误，则该助手响应会被单独标记为无效样本，并赋予 0 的奖励，即使其余轨迹可能获得正的评价器得分。

paragraphs.en: We use three efficiency mechanisms to make online RL feasible under costly desktop interaction. First, we adopt an asynchronous RL pipeline that allows the rollout policy to lag behind the latest policy by at most one version, enabling environment interaction and policy optimization to run in parallel. Second, we maintain per-task success-rate estimates and bias sampling toward tasks near the current capability frontier, down-weighting tasks that are already too easy or remain too difficult. Third, we apply bounded sliding-window visual-context segmentation to control context length and sample growth. Rollouts are split into segments and each segment can contain multiple assistant actions that contribute to loss. We apply the same sliding-window segmentation logic during rollout inference to maintain consistency between training and inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用三种效率机制，使在线强化学习在耗时的桌面交互环境下成为可能。 首先，我们采用异步强化学习流程，允许执行策略与最新策略最多相差一个版本，从而实现环境交互与策略优化的并行运行。 其次，我们为每个任务维护成功率估计值，并偏向于选择接近当前能力边界的任务进行采样，同时降低那些已经过于简单或仍然过于困难的任务的权重。 第三，我们应用有界滑动窗口视觉上下文分割技术，以控制上下文长度和样本增长。 执行过程被划分为多个片段，每个片段可以包含多个对损失函数有贡献的助手动作。 在执行推理时，我们也采用相同的滑动窗口分割逻辑，以保持训练与推理之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: In our preliminary RL experiments, standard GSPO exhibited a systematic drift toward code-intensive behavior as shown in Figure 4 . Specifically, as training progresses, the model increasingly favors code-related actions, ultimately resulting in a slight performance degradation relative to the initial SFT checkpoint. Within a mixed GUI/code training sample, a code action typically contains substantially more assistant tokens than a GUI click or keystroke. Standard GSPO averages token-level log-importance weights over all valid assistant tokens in the sample. Thus, even when a long code action constitutes only one of several GUI and code steps, it can dominate both the sample-level importance ratio and the clipping decision. This motivates an aggregation in which the weight assigned to each action step in the sample-level log-ratio is no longer determined by its token count.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们初步的强化学习实验中，标准的 GSPO 表现出一种系统性的向代码密集型行为偏移的趋势，如图 4 所示。 具体而言，随着训练的进行，模型越来越倾向于选择与代码相关的操作，最终导致其性能相较于初始的 SFT 检查点略有下降。 在混合的 GUI/代码训练样本中，一个代码操作通常包含比 GUI 点击或按键操作多得多的助手令牌。 标准的 GSPO 会在样本中所有有效的助手令牌上对令牌级别的日志重要性权重进行平均。 因此，即使一个较长的代码操作仅占多个 GUI 和代码步骤中的其中一个，它仍然可能主导样本级别的重要性比率以及裁剪决策。 这促使我们采用一种聚合方法：在样本级别的日志比率中，分配给每个操作步骤的权重不再由其令牌数量决定。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Benchmarks. Our evaluation centers on desktop environments, employing OSWorld 1 1 1 In this paper, “OSWorld” refers to “OSWorld-Verified”. ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) as our primary benchmark, which comprises 369 real-world tasks across five domains in an Ubuntu environment. Following common practice ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , we exclude the 8 Google Drive tasks, yielding a final set of 361 tasks. We report mean success rate as the primary metric. Beyond the Ubuntu environment, we additionally report results on WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) to evaluate cross-platform transfer to Windows.

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. For task synthesis, we use Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) for the Exploration and Evaluator Agents, and GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) for an independent quality review agent. For SFT, we train for one epoch on 31K successful filtered desktop samples synthesized by our pipeline and 40K general-purpose multimodal samples spanning code, reasoning, and related domains. For RL, we initialize from the dense OS-Helix-27B checkpoint and conduct a 1,000-step training run using rule-based evaluators as reward signals. Complete data details are provided in Appendix B , while training details are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 在任务合成中，我们使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6（Anthropic, 2026）作为探索智能体和评估智能体，并使用 GPT-5.5（OpenAI, 2026）作为独立的质量审查智能体。 对于 SFT，我们在由我们的流程合成的 31,000 个成功过滤的桌面样本以及涵盖代码、推理和相关领域的 40,000 个通用多模态样本上进行一个周期的训练。 对于 RL，我们从稠密的 OS-Helix-27B 检查点初始化，并使用基于规则的评估器作为奖励信号进行 1,000 步的训练。 完整的数据细节见附录 B，而训练细节见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that hybrid-policy training, rather than code-tool availability alone, yields substantial gains under matched-backbone comparisons. OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B improve over their corresponding Hybrid baselines by 16.25 and 14.43 absolute points, respectively. The largest gains occur in Office (+33.3 and +29.1 points) and Work. (+16.0 and +14.1 points). Office covers Calc, Impress, and Writer, where tasks often combine visually grounded interaction with rendered document states and precise transformations of structured artifacts. The Work. category comprises multi-application tasks that require task-relevant information to be handed off across applications and action modalities. These interpretations are consistent with the agent behavior study and representative trajectory audit in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 表1显示，在匹配背骨模型的比较中，混合策略训练（而非仅依赖代码工具的可用性）带来了显著的性能提升。 OS-Helix-27B 和 OS-Helix-35B-A3B 分别比其对应的混合基线模型提升了 16.25 和 14.43 个绝对分数点。 最大的性能提升出现在 Office（+33.3 和 +29.1 分）和 Work. 类别中。 （+16.0 和 +14.1 分）。 Office 类别涵盖 Calc、Impress 和 Writer，其中的任务通常需要结合视觉交互、渲染后的文档状态以及对结构化元素的精确变换。 Work. 类别包含多应用任务，这些任务要求将任务相关信息在不同应用程序和操作模式之间传递。 这些解释与附录 F 中关于智能体行为的研究及代表性轨迹审计结果一致。

paragraphs.en: Starting from the SFT policy, OS-Helix-27B-RL further raises the average success rate from 62.75% to 66.44%. Its incremental gains are concentrated in Professional (+23.10 points), OS (+7.61 points), and Daily (+6.69 points), whereas Office and Work. do not improve further over their already strong SFT results. This profile shows that RL provides additional gains in specific task domains rather than a uniform increase across the benchmark. The paired-bootstrap analysis of the aggregate difference is reported in Table 16 .
paragraphs.zh: 以 SFT 策略为起点，OS-Helix-27B-RL 进一步将平均成功率从 62.75% 提升至 66.44%。 其增量收益主要集中在「专业」（+23.10 分）、「操作系统」（+7.61 分）和「日常」（+6.69 分）领域，而「办公」和「工作」领域在原本已表现出色的 SFT 结果上未再提升。 这一分布特征表明，RL 带来的额外收益集中在特定任务领域，而非在整个基准测试中实现均匀提升。 汇总差异的配对自助法分析结果列于表 16 中。

paragraphs.en: In broader, non-controlled comparisons, OS-Helix-27B-RL is competitive with GPT-5-based agentic frameworks such as Agent-S3 ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ) and OS-Symphony ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , while newer and substantially larger general models remain stronger overall. Table 2 further shows that the gains transfer to WindowsAgentArena, where OS-Helix-27B-RL improves over the Qwen3.5-27B GUI baseline by 23.05 points. This provides evidence of cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena, with detailed results deferred to Appendix D.1 . Notably, the RL checkpoint also exhibits a larger improvement over the SFT checkpoint on WAA, suggesting that our online RL training further enhances the model’s generalization capability.
paragraphs.zh: 在更广泛、非受控的比较中，OS-Helix-27B-RL 与基于 GPT-5 的智能体框架（如 Agent-S3 (Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025) 和 OS-Symphony (Yang et al., 2026a)）具有竞争力，而更新且规模大得多的通用模型在整体表现上仍然更强。 表 2 进一步显示，这种性能提升也延续到了 WindowsAgentArena，其中 OS-Helix-27B-RL 相较于 Qwen3.5-27B GUI 基线模型提升了 23.05 分。 这为 WindowsAgentArena 上的跨平台迁移能力提供了证据，详细结果参见附录 D.1。 值得注意的是，RL 检查点在 WAA 上相较于 SFT 检查点也表现出更大的提升，这表明我们的在线 RL 训练进一步增强了模型的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Data robustness ablation. Table 3 tests whether the SFT gains require a strong trajectory teacher or data from OSWorld-related application domains. Panel (a) compares Kimi K2.5 ( Team et al., 2026b ) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) trajectories collected from the same 800 synthesized tasks. Panel (b) removes all samples from the nine OSWorld application domains, reducing the desktop SFT set from approximately 31K to 17K samples. Both teacher-derived datasets outperform the unadapted Hybrid backbone, while the stronger teacher performs better. Removing the nine related application domains shifts success from 62.75% to 62.31%. The retained performance after domain removal is consistent with capabilities that transfer beyond the evaluated application domains.
paragraphs.zh: 数据鲁棒性消融分析。 表 3 检验了 SFT 的增益是否需要一个强大的轨迹教师或来自 OSWorld 相关应用领域的数据。 图 (a) 比较了从相同的 800 个合成任务中收集的 Kimi K2.5（Team et al., 2026b）和 Claude Sonnet 4.6（Anthropic, 2026）的轨迹。 图 (b) 移除了来自九个 OSWorld 应用领域的全部样本，将桌面 SFT 数据集从约 31K 减少到 17K 个样本。 两种教师派生数据集的性能均优于未经适配的 Hybrid 基模型，而更强的教师模型表现更优。 移除这九个相关应用领域后，成功率从 62.75% 下降至 62.31%。 移除领域后保留的性能与能够迁移到所评估应用领域之外的能力一致。

paragraphs.en: Training-stage and algorithm ablation. Table 4 separates SFT, RL, and the RL objective. Panel (a) shows that SFT provides the main improvement over the unadapted Hybrid policy, RL alone changes little (+1.70 points), and applying RL after SFT yields the highest success rate of 66.44%. Panel (b) isolates the RL objective under the same SFT initialization, data, sampling strategy, reward signal, and optimization budget. Standard GSPO lowers success to 60.47% and increases the code-action rate from 27.9% under the SFT policy to 40.0%, whereas Step-balanced GSPO raises success while maintaining a 26.1% code-action rate close to the SFT policy. Together, these results suggest that action-step balancing improves evaluated performance while keeping the GUI/code action balance close to the SFT policy rather than drifting toward code-heavy behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 训练阶段与算法消融分析。 表4分别展示了SFT、RL以及RL目标函数的效果。 图(a)显示，SFT相较于未适配的混合策略实现了主要性能提升，单独使用RL仅带来微小变化（+1.70分），而在SFT之后应用RL则获得了66.44%的最高成功率。 图(b)在保持相同的SFT初始化、数据、采样策略、奖励信号和优化预算条件下，单独分析了RL目标函数的影响。 标准GSPO使成功率降至60.47%，并将代码-操作比率从SFT策略下的27.9%提升至40.0%；而步长平衡GSPO则在提升成功率的同时，将代码-操作比率维持在26.1%，接近SFT策略的水平。 综合来看，这些结果表明，对操作步骤进行平衡优化可在保持GUI/代码操作比例接近SFT策略的同时，提升评估性能，而非使其向以代码为主的行为偏移。

paragraphs.en: Unified GUI/code paradigm ablation. Table 5 disentangles code-tool availability from learned coordination. Panel (a) evaluates a fixed OS-Helix-27B checkpoint with and without code access. Panel (b) holds the backbone, SFT configuration, 10K-sample budget, and Hybrid evaluation harness fixed, changing only whether the SFT trajectories are GUI-only or hybrid GUI/code. Disabling code for the same policy still yields 52.13% success; enabling it adds 10.62 points, demonstrating retained GUI competence and code complementarity. With inference-time code access and the 10K-sample budget fixed, hybrid SFT adds 3.05 points over GUI-only SFT, indicating that training on hybrid trajectories enables a more effective use of shared GUI/code actions rather than relying on GUI-only supervision to generalize to code actions at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 统一 GUI/代码范式的消融分析。 表 5 将代码工具的可用性从学习到的协同作用中分离出来。 图 (a) 评估了固定 OS-Helix-27B 检查点在有无代码访问两种情况下的表现。 图 (b) 保持主干网络、SFT 配置、10K 样本预算和混合评估框架不变，仅改变 SFT 轨迹是纯 GUI 还是混合 GUI/代码。 即使对同一策略禁用代码，成功率仍为 52.13%；启用代码后成功率提升 10.62 个百分点，表明 GUI 能力得以保留且与代码形成互补。 在推理时具备代码访问权限且固定 10K 样本预算的情况下，混合 SFT 比纯 GUI SFT 多获得 3.05 个百分点，说明基于混合轨迹的训练能更有效地利用共享的 GUI/代码操作，而非仅依赖纯 GUI 的监督来推广到推理时的代码操作。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy versus efficiency. In Figure 3 , evaluator scores above 0.5 are counted as successes and scores below 0.5 as failures. Panel (a) reports mean interaction steps. All tasks and Own successes use each run’s complete and successful task sets, respectively, whereas Joint successes and Joint failures retain only shared tasks on which all three policies have the same binary outcome, controlling for task-composition differences. Panel (b) reports cumulative Success@ K K on OSWorld. Across the full set, successful episodes, and outcome-matched subsets, OS-Helix-27B uses fewer interactions while covering more successes under small step budgets. Learned modality routing therefore improves both execution efficiency and task coverage, an effect not reproduced by enabling code only at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 准确性与效率的权衡。 在图3中，评分高于0.5的评估结果被视为成功，而低于0.5的则被视为失败。 子图（a）报告了平均交互步数。 所有任务以及“自身”成功均分别使用每次运行中完整且成功的任务集；而“联合”成功与“联合”失败则仅保留所有三种策略具有相同二元结果的共享任务，以控制任务构成差异的影响。 子图（b）报告了OSWorld上的累积Success@K指标。 在整个数据集、成功回合以及结果匹配的子集中，OS-Helix-27B在步数预算较小时所需的交互更少，同时实现了更多的成功。 因此，通过训练得到的模态路由能够同时提升执行效率和任务覆盖范围，而仅在推理阶段启用代码则无法重现这一效果。

paragraphs.en: Why step balance matters. Panel (a) of Figure 4 uses the fraction of actions invoking code at each online RL update as a behavioral diagnostic. Under the same training setup, standard GSPO progressively drifts toward code-intensive behavior, whereas Step-balanced GSPO remains lower and more stable over the shared observed horizon. Panel (b) reports repeated-sampling coverage. Compared with the SFT policy, OS-Helix-27B-RL improves Pass@1 from 62.75% to 66.44% (+3.69 points) and Pass@3 from 70.88% to 76.44% (+5.56 points), with the latter supported by a paired-bootstrap confidence interval of 95% [2.24,8.97]. The larger gain under Pass@3 indicates that RL does more than strengthen a single preferred trajectory and increases the probability of discovering distinct successful trajectories across independent attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 步平衡为何重要。 图 4 的 (a) 图使用每次在线强化学习更新中调用代码的行为比例作为行为诊断指标。 在相同的训练设置下，标准的 GSPO 会逐渐偏向代码密集型行为，而步平衡 GSPO 在整个共享观察时域内则保持较低且更稳定。 (b) 图报告了重复采样的覆盖情况。 与 SFT 策略相比，OS-Helix-27B-RL 将 Pass@1 从 62.75% 提升至 66.44%（+3.69 个百分点），Pass@3 从 70.88% 提升至 76.44%（+5.56 个百分点），其中后者的提升由 95% 的配对自助置信区间 [2.24,8.97] 所支持。 Pass@3 下更大的提升表明，强化学习不仅强化了单一优选轨迹，还提高了在独立尝试中发现不同成功轨迹的概率。

paragraphs.en: Training scaling and data distributions. Panels (c)–(f) of Figure 4 further examine the performance scaling and instruction distributions. Panel (c) reports success for the Work. category and the overall average across checkpoints from the first SFT epoch. Panel (d) holds the desktop data fixed and varies the fraction of the 40K general-purpose multimodal pool from 0% to 100%. Both sets of curves improve overall as the supervision grows, indicating complementary contributions from hybrid trajectories and general-purpose data. Panels (e)–(f) show kernel-density estimates of these per-task statistics. We encode each instruction with text-embedding-3-large ( OpenAI, 2024 ) , L2-normalize the embedding, and compute cosine similarity by vector dot product. The cross-corpus similarity to OSWorld is comparable to OSWorld’s internal-instruction similarity, indicating limited instruction-level overlap. Together with domain-removal ablation in Table 3 , this provides complementary evidence against direct instruction overlap or reliance on data from the evaluated domains. Meanwhile, the synthesized corpus exhibits a higher but still broadly spread internal-similarity distribution, suggesting that it captures shared, transferable desktop-task structure rather than collapsing to a narrow instruction template family.
paragraphs.zh: 训练扩展与数据分布。 图 4 的 (c)–(f) 子图进一步考察了性能扩展与指令分布。 子图 (c) 报告了 Work 类别的成功率，以及首个 SFT 周期中各检查点的总体平均值。 子图 (d) 保持桌面数据不变，并将 40K 通用多模态数据池的比例从 0% 变化到 100%。 随着监督强度的增加，两组曲线均呈现整体改善趋势，表明混合轨迹与通用数据存在互补性贡献。 子图 (e)–(f) 展示了这些按任务统计量的核密度估计。 我们使用 text-embedding-3-large（OpenAI, 2024）对每条指令进行编码，对嵌入向量进行 L2 归一化，并通过向量点积计算余弦相似度。 与 OSWorld 的跨语料库相似度与 OSWorld 的内部指令相似度相当，表明指令层面的重叠有限。 结合表 3 中的领域移除消融实验，这一结果提供了补充证据，排除了指令直接重叠或依赖所评估领域数据的可能性。 与此同时，合成语料库展现出更高但分布仍较广泛的内部相似度，这表明其捕捉到了共享且可迁移的桌面任务结构，而非简化为狭窄的指令模板家族。

sents.en: Meanwhile, the synthesized corpus exhibits a higher but still broadly spread internal-similarity distribution, suggesting that it captures shared, transferable desktop-task structure rather than collapsing to a narrow instruction template family.
sents.zh: 与此同时，合成语料库展现出更高但分布仍较广泛的内部相似度，这表明其捕捉到了共享且可迁移的桌面任务结构，而非简化为狭窄的指令模板家族。

paragraphs.en: We present OS-Helix, a native hybrid computer-using agent trained end-to-end through scalable executable desktop task synthesis, hybrid SFT, and Step-balanced GSPO online RL, designed to natively coordinate heterogeneous GUI and code actions within a single policy. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. OS-Helix-27B-RL also transfers to WindowsAgentArena with 63.87% success, surpassing GPT-5-based framework methods on both benchmarks. Ablations and behavioral analyses show that SFT provides the main gain, hybrid supervision outperforms GUI-only supervision at a fixed scale, and learned routing improves both execution efficiency and task coverage beyond code access alone. Under matched RL settings, Step-balanced GSPO outperforms standard GSPO and mitigates its drift toward code-intensive behavior, while RL increases Pass@3 from 70.88% to 76.44%, indicating broader discovery of successful trajectories across independent attempts. These findings establish native GUI/code coordination as a learnable hybrid paradigm and provide a reproducible foundation for further research on hybrid computer-using agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 OS-Helix，这是一种原生混合计算机使用智能体，通过可扩展的可执行桌面任务合成、混合 SFT 和 Step-balanced GSPO 在线 RL 进行端到端训练，旨在单一策略内原生协调异构的 GUI 和代码操作。 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，OS-Helix-27B 和 OS-Helix-35B-A3B 相较于其匹配的 Qwen3.5 混合基线模型分别实现了 35.0% 和 33.7% 的相对提升，而 OS-Helix-27B-RL 则进一步提升了 42.9%，成功率达到 66.44%。 OS-Helix-27B-RL 也成功迁移到 WindowsAgentArena，成功率达到 63.87%，在两项基准测试中均超越了基于 GPT-5 的框架方法。 消融实验和行为分析表明，SFT 带来了主要性能提升，在固定规模下混合监督优于仅针对 GUI 的监督，而学习到的路由机制在执行效率和任务覆盖范围方面均超越了单纯依赖代码访问的方法。 在匹配的 RL 设置下，Step-balanced GSPO 的表现优于标准 GSPO，并缓解了其向代码密集型行为偏移的趋势；同时，RL 将 Pass@3 从 70.88% 提升至 76.44%，表明在独立尝试中成功轨迹的发现范围更广。 这些研究结果确立了原生 GUI/代码协调是一种可学习的混合范式，并为进一步研究混合计算机使用智能体提供了可复现的基础。

paragraphs.en: This work does not involve human-subject studies or the collection of private data from real users. We study training methods for general-purpose computer-using agents, and conduct all trajectory collection, reinforcement learning, and evaluation in controlled, isolated Ubuntu virtual machines. The VMs use fixed application versions and a curated local file library, and are separated from personal host files and credentials. This setup reduces the risk that exploratory actions during research inadvertently modify host state or access unauthorized resources.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究不涉及人类受试者研究，也不从真实用户处收集私人数据。 我们研究通用计算机使用智能体的训练方法，并在受控、隔离的 Ubuntu 虚拟机中完成所有轨迹收集、强化学习和评估。 这些虚拟机使用固定版本的应用程序和经过筛选的本地文件库，并与个人主机文件和凭证分离。 这种设置降低了研究过程中探索性操作无意中修改主机状态或访问未授权资源的风险。

sents.zh: 本研究不涉及人类受试者研究，也不从真实用户处收集私人数据。

sents.en: This setup reduces the risk that exploratory actions during research inadvertently modify host state or access unauthorized resources.
sents.zh: 这种设置降低了研究过程中探索性操作无意中修改主机状态或访问未授权资源的风险。

paragraphs.en: Although the experiments themselves present no substantial direct ethical risk, deploying agents with combined GUI interaction and code execution on real devices raises important safety and privacy concerns. Such agents can continuously observe screen content, modify local files, and execute Python or Bash, and may therefore encounter personally identifiable information, confidential documents, or authentication credentials. They may also be exposed to prompt injection through interface content or external files. Code actions further increase the potential impact of erroneous behavior or malicious workflows. The isolated experimental setting used in this work does not resolve these deployment-time risks.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管实验本身并未带来任何重大的直接伦理风险，但在真实设备上部署兼具 GUI 交互和代码执行能力的智能体，却引发了重要的安全与隐私问题。 这类智能体能够持续观察屏幕内容、修改本地文件并执行 Python 或 Bash 脚本，因此可能会接触到个人身份信息、机密文件或认证凭证。 它们还可能通过界面内容或外部文件受到提示注入攻击。 代码操作进一步放大了错误行为或恶意工作流可能造成的影响。 本研究采用的隔离实验环境并未解决这些部署阶段的风险。

sents.en: The isolated experimental setting used in this work does not resolve these deployment-time risks.
sents.zh: 本研究采用的隔离实验环境并未解决这些部署阶段的风险。

paragraphs.en: Real-world deployment should follow least-privilege and safety-by-design principles. These include granular permissions over applications, directories, networks, and code execution; explicit human confirmation before irreversible, credential-bearing, or otherwise high-impact operations; runtime policy checks, sandboxed execution, audit logs, and post-action verification; and data minimization and sanitization for screenshots, trajectories, and tool outputs. Users should retain the ability to define and revoke the agent’s authority, with sensitive applications such as banking, private communication, and credential management inaccessible by default. Because general-purpose automation is inherently dual use, future CUA research should advance capabilities together with systematic red teaming, interpretable action auditing, and reliable human takeover mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 实际部署应遵循最小权限和安全性优先设计原则。 这些原则包括：对应用程序、目录、网络和代码执行实施精细权限控制；在执行不可逆、涉及凭证或具有其他高影响的操作前，必须经过明确的人工确认；进行运行时策略检查、沙盒化执行、审计日志记录和行动后验证；以及对截图、轨迹和工具输出数据进行最小化和净化处理。 用户应保留定义和撤销智能体权限的能力，且银行服务、私人通信和凭证管理等敏感应用默认应保持不可访问状态。 由于通用自动化本质上具有双重用途，未来的CUA研究应在提升能力的同时，同步推进系统性的红队测试、可解释的行动审计以及可靠的人工接管机制。

paragraphs.en: OS-Helix is an initial step toward native GUI/code hybrid computer use, with remaining limitations centered primarily on computational and API resource constraints.
paragraphs.zh: OS-Helix 是迈向原生 GUI/代码混合计算机使用方式的第一步，其剩余的局限性主要集中在计算能力和 API 资源限制上。

paragraphs.en: First, desktop environments are difficult to scale comprehensively: even an application–artifact desktop infrastructure spanning diverse applications cannot cover the full diversity of real user machines, private artifacts, application versions, and personalized configurations. Future work should further expand the application and artifact ecosystem and study broader randomization of system states and user configurations while preserving reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，桌面环境难以实现全面扩展：即使是一个涵盖多种应用程序的应用程序–工件桌面基础设施，也无法覆盖真实用户机器的全部多样性，包括私有工件、应用程序版本和个性化配置。 未来的工作应进一步扩展应用程序和工件生态系统，并在保持可重复性的同时，研究系统状态和用户配置的更广泛随机化。

sents.en: First, desktop environments are difficult to scale comprehensively: even an application–artifact desktop infrastructure spanning diverse applications cannot cover the full diversity of real user machines, private artifacts, application versions, and personalized configurations.
sents.zh: 首先，桌面环境难以实现全面扩展：即使是一个涵盖多种应用程序的应用程序–工件桌面基础设施，也无法覆盖真实用户机器的全部多样性，包括私有工件、应用程序版本和个性化配置。

sents.en: Future work should further expand the application and artifact ecosystem and study broader randomization of system states and user configurations while preserving reproducibility.
sents.zh: 未来的工作应进一步扩展应用程序和工件生态系统，并在保持可重复性的同时，研究系统状态和用户配置的更广泛随机化。

paragraphs.en: Second, automatic verification remains imperfect. Unlike software engineering tasks, where gold final states can be obtained deterministically, automated CUA task synthesis under limited resources cannot reliably capture ground-truth terminal states—tasks may therefore be subject to feasibility risks, and the resulting evaluators carry intrinsic brittleness. Concretely, rule-based evaluators reliably cover many file-backed tasks but require careful construction and often depend on specific application versions or export formats; more fundamentally, even when an agent’s execution is semantically near-correct, inconsistent strictness in file-attribute checks can reduce the score to zero. Rubric-based partial scoring, adopted in several recent works including ours, partially alleviates this issue but does not resolve it entirely. VLM-based evaluators extend coverage to textual outputs and visual outcomes, yet may miss fine-grained discrepancies; more critically, due to their inherent brittleness, existing RL engineering practice typically excludes VLM-based scoring from the reward signal altogether, concentrating construction effort on rule-based evaluators—which in turn constrains the types and diversity of tasks that can be incorporated into training. Future work should develop stronger evaluator-generation, repair, and validation pipelines, and systematically study cross-evaluator agreement as well as robustness to reward hacking.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，自动验证仍然不完美。 与软件工程任务不同，后者可以确定地获得黄金最终状态；而在资源有限的情况下，自动化 CUA 任务合成无法可靠地捕捉真实终端状态——因此任务可能面临可行性风险，由此产生的评估器也存在内在的脆弱性。 具体而言，基于规则的评估器能够可靠地覆盖许多有文件支持的任务，但需要精心设计，并且通常依赖特定的应用程序版本或导出格式；更根本的是，即使智能体的执行在语义上接近正确，文件属性检查中不一致的严格程度也可能将分数降至零。 基于评分标准的部分评分方法已被包括我们研究在内的几项近期工作所采用，它在一定程度上缓解了这一问题，但并未完全解决。 基于 VLM 的评估器将覆盖范围扩展到了文本输出和视觉结果，但仍可能忽略细微差异；更关键的是，由于其固有的脆弱性，现有的强化学习工程实践通常完全排除基于 VLM 的评分在奖励信号中的使用，并将构建工作集中在基于规则的评估器上——这反过来又限制了可以纳入训练的任务类型和多样性。 未来的研究应开发更强大的评估器生成、修复和验证流程，并系统性地研究跨评估器的一致性以及对奖励欺骗的鲁棒性。

sents.zh: 未来的研究应开发更强大的评估器生成、修复和验证流程，并系统性地研究跨评估器的一致性以及对奖励欺骗的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Third, our agentic RL experiments are subject to certain limitations imposed by available computational resources. RL training was conducted only on the dense 27B model with relatively conservative hyperparameter settings; the total number of training steps was likewise constrained, precluding a systematic investigation of the scaling behavior of agentic RL. For OS-Helix-35B-A3B, despite its strong performance in SFT experiments, the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture introduces non-trivial additional challenges in training-inference consistency and optimization stability during agentic RL, making it difficult to support this training pipeline reliably under current resource conditions. We regard a more thorough exploration of RL training dynamics and scaling laws, together with a stable extension of Step-balanced GSPO to larger MoE computer-using agents, as an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，我们的智能体强化学习实验受到可用计算资源所带来的一些限制。 强化学习训练仅在高密度 27B 模型上进行，且采用了相对保守的超参数设置；训练步数的总量同样受到限制，因此无法对智能体强化学习的扩展行为进行系统性研究。 对于 OS-Helix-35B-A3B，尽管其在 SFT 实验中表现优异，但其专家混合（MoE）架构在智能体强化学习过程中给训练与推理的一致性以及优化稳定性带来了非微不足道的额外挑战，使得在当前资源条件下难以可靠地支持该训练流程。 我们将更深入地探索强化学习训练动态和扩展规律，同时将 Step-balanced GSPO 稳定地扩展到更大规模的 MoE 计算机使用智能体中，视为未来工作的重要方向。

sents.en: Third, our agentic RL experiments are subject to certain limitations imposed by available computational resources.

paragraphs.en: Beyond scaling, we believe the community is now at an inflection point where recursive self-improvement (RSI) deserves serious consideration. As CUA models attain a meaningful level of general computer-use capability, the model itself can serve as its own teacher: rolling out interaction trajectories on existing tasks, providing the training signal for the next iteration, and progressively improving through this self-bootstrapping loop. Rather than relying solely on human demonstration or externally curated data, such a paradigm allows the agent to continuously generate its own training trajectories with growing quality as capability improves and feed them back into subsequent training rounds. We view this self-evolving, teacher-free training paradigm as one of the most promising long-term directions for advancing CUA agents.
paragraphs.zh: 除了扩展规模之外，我们认为社区目前正处于一个转折点，此时递归自我改进（RSI）值得认真考虑。 随着CUA模型达到有意义的通用计算机使用能力水平，模型本身可以充当自己的教师：在现有任务上展开交互轨迹，为下一次迭代提供训练信号，并通过这种自我启动循环逐步提升性能。 与仅依赖人类演示或外部整理的数据不同，这种模式允许智能体随着能力的提升而持续生成质量日益提高的自身训练轨迹，并将其反馈到后续的训练轮次中。 我们将这种自我演进、无需教师的训练模式视为推动CUA智能体发展的最具前景的长期方向之一。

paragraphs.en: Finally, many existing desktop benchmarks were originally designed for GUI-only agents, with task design, reference solutions, and evaluation functions all implicitly centered on visual interaction paths. Although their tasks can often be completed with hybrid strategies, existing evaluators may not capture every valid GUI/code solution. Furthermore, using success rate as the sole metric is overly coarse: it neither distinguishes whether the agent selected the more efficient modality nor captures potential safety risks inherent to hybrid execution, such as unintended side effects of code execution or inadvertent system-level operations.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，许多现有的桌面基准测试最初是为仅使用 GUI 的智能体设计的，其任务设计、参考解决方案和评估功能都隐式地以视觉交互路径为中心。 尽管这些任务通常可以通过混合策略完成，但现有的评估工具可能无法捕捉到所有有效的 GUI/代码解决方案。 此外，仅将成功率作为唯一指标是过于粗略的：它既无法区分智能体是否选择了更高效的模态，也无法捕捉到混合执行中潜在的安全风险，例如代码执行带来的意外副作用或无意的系统级操作。

paragraphs.en: A particularly promising complementary direction is the migration and adaptation of existing general-purpose agent benchmarks such as GDPval ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ) and Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026b ) into GUI environments. These benchmarks are inherently designed around authentic artifact manipulation and complex reasoning tasks, and thus naturally encompass diverse environment states and authentic artifacts. Porting them into desktop GUI settings not only amortizes the high cost of designing tasks from scratch, but also enables a unified evaluation framework that simultaneously exercises GUI interaction, code execution, and their hybrid coordination, providing a more ecologically valid testbed for deeply probing the GUI/code hybrid-driving paradigm. Future benchmarks should explicitly support hybrid computer use from the task-design stage onward, providing multi-path reference solutions and jointly evaluating terminal-state correctness, execution efficiency, modality-selection appropriateness, and safety, thereby offering a more comprehensive and equitable evaluation framework for next-generation hybrid agents.
paragraphs.zh: 一个尤其有前景的补充方向，是将现有的通用智能体基准测试（如 GDPval（Patwardhan 等人，2026）和 Agents’ Last Exam（Sun 等人，2026b））迁移并适配到 GUI 环境中。 这些基准测试本质上围绕真实的物品操控和复杂推理任务而设计，因此天然涵盖了多样的环境状态和真实物品。 将它们移植到桌面 GUI 环境中，不仅能摊销从头设计任务的高成本，还能建立一个统一的评估框架，同时检验 GUI 交互、代码执行及其混合协调能力，从而为深入探索 GUI/代码混合驱动范式提供更符合生态实际性的测试平台。 未来的基准测试应从任务设计阶段起就明确支持混合计算机使用方式，提供多路径参考解决方案，并联合评估终端状态的正确性、执行效率、模态选择的适宜性和安全性，从而为下一代混合智能体提供更全面、更公平的评估框架。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 compares recent CUA task- and environment-synthesis pipelines across five dimensions: task grounding, application scaling, authentic artifact integration, cross-application task support, and executable evaluation. The comparison is organized along the axis of synthesis coverage rather than data scale or maturity. The broader contribution of OS-Helix is to extend exploration-grounded task generation toward artifact-grounded executable desktop-state construction: the pipeline jointly addresses K/E/C grounding, application scaling, authentic artifact-backed state initialization, and executable rule-based evaluation within a single coherent framework. Concretely, an application–artifact compatibility graph organizes valid pairings of application configurations and supported artifact types or file formats, enabling reproducible initial states to be instantiated systematically. The evaluator pipeline verifies persistent terminal outcomes rather than constraining the action sequence, supporting diverse task objectives and evaluation criteria across application domains and providing the infrastructure for subsequent hybrid-policy training.
paragraphs.zh: 表6从五个维度比较了近期CUA任务与环境合成流程：任务基础、应用扩展、真实工件集成、跨应用任务支持以及可执行评估。 该比较以合成覆盖范围为轴进行组织，而非数据规模或成熟度。 OS-Helix的更广泛贡献在于将基于探索的任务生成方法延伸至基于工件的可执行桌面状态构建：该流程在一个统一连贯的框架内同时解决了K/E/C基础、应用扩展、由真实工件支持的状态初始化以及可执行的规则 기반评估问题。 具体而言，一个应用-工件兼容性图用于组织应用配置与支持工件类型或文件格式的有效组合，从而能够系统化地实例化可重复的初始状态。 评估流程验证的是持久的终端结果，而非限制动作序列，这支持了跨应用领域的多样化任务目标和评估标准，并为后续的混合策略训练提供了基础设施。

paragraphs.en: Our everything-is-a-file abstraction treats the file system as a common inspection interface rather than as a restriction on where a task state must originate. A terminal condition may initially reside in a downloaded web page, an in-memory application state, an unsaved layout, or a persistent user artifact. We attempt to materialize the relevant condition into a VM-resident file representation whenever this can preserve the semantics needed for evaluation: a web state may be downloaded or serialized locally, an in-memory result may be exported, and an answer may be written to a structured or plain-text file. This externalization separates the location of a state from its verifiable representation and allows heterogeneous desktop objectives to share a common evaluation interface.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的“一切皆文件”抽象方法将文件系统视为一个通用的检查接口，而非任务状态必须来源的限制。 终端条件最初可能存在于下载的网络页面、内存中的应用程序状态、未保存的布局或持久的用户产物中。 只要能够保留评估所需的语义，我们就会尝试将相关条件具象化为虚拟机内的文件表示：网络状态可以下载或本地序列化，内存中的结果可以导出，而答案则可以写入结构化文件或纯文本文件。 这种外部化将状态的位置与其可验证的表示分离开来，并使异构的桌面目标能够共享一个通用的评估接口。

paragraphs.en: The materialization step is not uniformly lossless. Some conditions, such as exact document structure, metadata, or serialized application state, admit faithful programmatic inspection; others depend on rendered layout, canvas appearance, transient UI state, or content for which serialization does not preserve the relevant evidence. Evaluator selection therefore reflects an observability trade-off: rule-based checks are used when a deterministic file or command representation captures the required semantics, VLM-based checks are used when visual or otherwise non-serializable evidence is essential, and hybrid evaluators combine the two when they provide complementary evidence. The resulting evaluator is agnostic to whether the agent reached the terminal condition through GUI actions, code execution, or their combination.
paragraphs.zh: 具体化步骤并非始终无损。 某些条件，例如精确的文档结构、元数据或序列化的应用程序状态，允许通过程序进行忠实检查；而其他条件则依赖于渲染后的布局、画布外观、瞬时的用户界面状态，或序列化无法保留相关证据的内容。 因此，评估器的选择体现了一种可观察性的权衡：当确定性的文件或命令表示能够捕捉所需语义时，会使用基于规则的检查；当视觉或其他非序列化的证据至关重要时，则会使用基于 VLM 的检查；而当两者能提供互补的证据时，混合评估器会将二者结合使用。 由此产生的评估器不关心智能体是通过 GUI 操作、代码执行还是两者的组合达到终端条件的。

sents.en: Some conditions, such as exact document structure, metadata, or serialized application state, admit faithful programmatic inspection; others depend on rendered layout, canvas appearance, transient UI state, or content for which serialization does not preserve the relevant evidence.

paragraphs.en: The primary task-synthesis pipeline instantiates states through the application–artifact compatibility graph. The pipeline then follows a one-way information flow: application and artifact configurations determine the initialization context; the Exploration Agent produces a structured instruction proposal and textual success conditions; the independent Evaluator Agent compiles the frozen conditions into rule-based or visual checks; and each independently validated instruction-evaluator pair enters the task pool.
paragraphs.zh: 主要任务合成流程通过应用程序–工件兼容性图来实例化状态。 随后，该流程遵循单向信息流：应用程序和工件的配置决定初始化上下文；探索智能体生成结构化的指令提案和文本形式的成功条件；独立的评估智能体将已固定的条件编译为基于规则或视觉的检查项；每个经过独立验证的指令–评估器组合都会进入任务池。

paragraphs.en: For each application, we record a canonical name, version, supported artifact types and file formats, launch commands, and initialization templates, and use these fields to build the application–artifact compatibility graph. Each synthesis episode first restores a controlled VM snapshot and samples a primary application, then selects zero or more compatible artifacts through the graph according to the application’s initialization templates. For every sampled pre-existing artifact, initialization creates a VM-resident, evaluator-only golden copy before task execution while leaving the original path as the active task target; this copy is bound to the task configuration and may serve as the expected reference in subsequent content or structural comparisons. The system then provides the Exploration Agent with application metadata, exact file paths, launch configuration, an application tutorial, global application memory, and an initial screenshot.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个应用程序，我们会记录其规范名称、版本、支持的工件类型和文件格式、启动命令以及初始化模板，并利用这些字段构建应用程序与工件的兼容性图。 每次合成过程首先会恢复一个受控的虚拟机快照并采样一个主应用程序，然后依据该应用程序的初始化模板，通过兼容性图选择零个或多个兼容的工件。 对于每个采样到的现有工件，初始化过程会在任务执行前创建一个位于虚拟机内且仅用于评估的黄金副本，同时保留原始路径作为当前任务的活跃目标；该副本会与任务配置绑定，并可能作为后续内容或结构比较中的预期参考。 随后，系统会向探索智能体提供应用程序元数据、精确的文件路径、启动配置、应用程序教程、全局应用程序内存以及一张初始截图。

paragraphs.en: The following partial PyCharm configuration illustrates how application metadata connects application initialization with artifact-library sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 以下部分的 PyCharm 配置说明了应用程序元数据如何将应用程序初始化与工件库采样连接起来。

paragraphs.en: The version field fixes the application version assumed by task synthesis, trajectory collection, and evaluator implementation, while type declares the artifact or project types that the application can directly consume. The two entries in commands are alternative initialization templates: the first launches an empty application, and the second launches the application with a sampled artifact. The position-aligned values in random are normalized into initialization probabilities; hence [10, 90] assigns approximately 10% probability to an empty PyCharm launch and 90% to a file- or project-backed launch. When the second template is selected, the system randomly samples an absolute file path whose type is compatible with type from the artifact library and substitutes it for PATH before executing the command. The related_app and related_type fields retain compatibility relations among applications and artifact types for selecting conventional companion applications and for the graph-guided cross-application prototype.
paragraphs.zh: version 字段规定了任务合成、轨迹收集和评估器实现所假设的应用程序版本，而 type 则声明了应用程序可以直接使用的工件或项目类型。 commands 中的两个条目是替代的初始化模板：第一个启动一个空的应用程序，第二个则启动一个带有采样工件的应用程序。 random 中位置对齐的值会被归一化为初始化概率；因此 [10, 90] 会将约 10% 的概率分配给启动空的 PyCharm，将 90% 分配给基于文件或项目的启动。 当选择第二个模板时，系统会从工件库中随机采样一个与 type 兼容的绝对文件路径，并在执行命令前将其替换为 PATH。 related_app 和 related_type 字段保留了应用程序和工件类型之间的兼容性关系，用于选择常规配套应用程序以及图引导的跨应用程序原型。

paragraphs.en: This declarative configuration is what makes application scaling reproducible rather than a collection of ad hoc launch scripts. Adding an application requires specifying its version, launch procedures, supported artifact types, initialization probabilities, and optional relations to companion applications. The compatibility graph then filters valid application–artifact pairings before an episode is instantiated in a fixed VM, allowing new applications and artifact types to expand the executable state space while preserving initialization and sampling semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 正是这种声明式配置使得应用程序的扩展具有可重复性，而不仅仅是一组临时编写的启动脚本。 添加一个应用程序需要指定其版本、启动流程、支持的艺术品类型、初始化概率以及与配套应用程序的可选关系。 兼容性图随后会过滤有效的应用程序与艺术品的配对，在某个固定虚拟机中实例化一个回合之前完成这一过程，从而允许新的应用程序和艺术品种类扩展可执行状态空间，同时保持初始化和采样语义不变。
